acts.label: Prologue
acts.desc: Host Ira Glass plays a strange voicemail left by a 96-year-old surgeon about a letter that was written five decades ago.

acts.label: Act One
acts.desc: Producer Lilly Sullivan reports out that voicemail.
acts.title: Humor Is Not The Best Medicine

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: On his deathbed, a wealthy man in Toronto decides to make some trouble. Hundreds of babies are involved. Stephanie Foo tells the story.
acts.title: Babies Got Bank

acts.label: Act Three
acts.desc: Cyclist Mike Friedman said something to cyclist Ian Dille in the middle of a race that ate at both of them for years. Jared Marcelle tells the story.

songs.t: How Long Do I Have to Wait For You

acts.title: Meatball and Chain
